# Explore the Technology in Oura Ring 4

[![](https://ouraring.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/unnamed-5.png)](https://ouraring.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/unnamed-5.png "Explore the Technology in Oura Ring 4")

Author:   [Emilina Lomas](https://ouraring.com/blog/author/emilina-lomas/ "Post by Emilina Lomas")    Published on:  March 18, 2025

Reviewed by: [Xi Zhang, PhD, VP, Health Sensing](https://ouraring.com/blog/reviewed-by/xi-zhang-phd-vp-health-sensing/)

[Oura Ring](https://ouraring.com/) has become a leader in personal health tracking with its advanced, discreet technology. It goes beyond basic step counting, delving deep into [sleep,](https://ouraring.com/blog/how-does-the-oura-ring-track-my-sleep/?srsltid=AfmBOopN3RDakSIOM8gxomIxHAF0PvGtJuhr974-v5WDYlFR-qnCHCGC) [cardiovascular health](https://ouraring.com/heart-health), [cycle tracking](https://ouraring.com/blog/oura-cycle-insights/), [stress](https://ouraring.com/stress), [illness detection](https://ouraring.com/blog/symptom-radar/), and more than 30 other biometrics. 

[Oura Ring 4](https://ouraring.com/product/rings/oura-ring-4/silver?srsltid=AfmBOoodyyROB_jWcBMu8lHQIC4C_QPaCPMzCVt8IFVhspgb_TdanxnF) represents the pinnacle of wearable health technology, integrating and minimizing advanced sensors, proprietary algorithms, and continuous data analysis into a comfortable ring form-factor to deliver highly accurate health insights.

Learn more about the cutting-edge technology that powers Oura Ring 4—which, in turn, empowers Oura members to take control of their health and wellbeing. 

Sleeker. Smarter. Made for you.

[Shop Oura Ring 4](https://ouraring.com/store/rings/oura-ring-4)

## **Advanced Sensor Suite**

Oura Ring 4 features a completely redesigned multi-sensor system, offering unparalleled accuracy.

* **18-path multi-wavelength photoplethysmography (PPG)**:
  + Red and infrared LEDs measure blood oxygen levels (SpO2) while you sleep.
  + Green and infrared LEDs track heart rate (HR) and heart rate variability (HRV) 24/7, as well as respiration rate during sleep.
* **Digital temperature sensor**: measures skin temperature variations for [early signs of sickness](https://ouraring.com/blog/symptom-radar/?srsltid=AfmBOorm1NCEBeuiV7FOeUG7eBnx-whCxnvHY8G1Uk75zyfLCFoCRObl), [menstrual cycle tracking,](https://ouraring.com/blog/oura-cycle-insights/) and [recovery insights](https://support.ouraring.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057791533-Readiness-Contributors#:~:text=Recovery%20Index%20measures%20the%20time,of%20sleep%20after%20this%20point.).
* **3D accelerometer**: monitors [movement and activity 24/7,](https://ouraring.com/activity-and-movement) capturing steps, exercise intensity, and nighttime restlessness.
* **Groundbreaking** [**Smart Sensing**](https://ouraring.com/blog/smart-sensing/) **technology**: dynamically adjusts PPG sensor configurations based on multiple contexts and conditions, significantly improving signal fidelity and battery efficiency.

## **Proprietary Algorithms for Data Analysis**

The research-grade sensors power state-of-the-art machine-learning algorithms to deliver the most accurate, continuous health metrics and insights, day and night—all while optimizing battery life.

* Algorithms adapt to your personal baseline, adjusting contributors to your [Sleep](https://support.ouraring.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025445574-Sleep-Score), [Activity](https://ouraring.com/blog/activity-score/), and [Readiness Scores](https://ouraring.com/blog/readiness-score/?srsltid=AfmBOoqvA_q7pnnxhQrQwrIADwwg6JsM8xdgZCjTEdDcdqK3DfSkCBH5) over time.
* Oura’s advanced [machine-learning-based sleep staging algorithm](https://ouraring.com/blog/new-sleep-staging-algorithm/) has been [scientifically validated](https://www.mdpi.com/1424-8220/21/13/4302) against polysomnography (PSG)—the gold standard of sleep tracking—allowing it to generate precise sleep stage graphs (hypnograms).
* [Automatic Activity Detection (AAD)](https://ouraring.com/blog/automatic-activity-detection/) intelligently detects 40+ workouts without manual input, delivering average heart rate and heart rate zones after the activity.
* Smart Sensing reduces data gaps, leading to a 120% improvement in signal quality for [blood oxygen sensing (SpO2)](https://ouraring.com/blog/blood-oxygen-sensing-spo2/), 31% improvement in [nighttime heart rate tracking](https://ouraring.com/blog/sleeping-heart-rate/?srsltid=AfmBOop50Sguz9dAFw-l6TDKRoBn97D7fPjwIabOmsvavma4YUUv6vgO), and a 7% improvement in daytime heart rate accuracy.

*RELATED:* [*Technology in Oura Ring Gen3*](https://ouraring.com/blog/ring-technology/)

## **Bluetooth Connectivity**

The bluetooth technology in Oura Ring is only active during a small portion (well below 1%) of each day. Data is transmitted more continuously when the ring syncs with the app and during firmware updates. [Airplane mode](https://support.ouraring.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025445814-Airplane-Mode) disables all radio transmission from Oura Ring.

The limit for SAR (Specific Absorption Rate) for a device such as Oura Ring is 2.0 W/kg for head and body, and Oura’s SAR level is 0.0003 W/kg. In other words, the electromagnetic field (EMF) levels of Oura Ring are about *3,000 times* lower than a typical smartphone.

## **Dimensions and Weight**

* Width: 7.90 mm
* Thickness: 2.88mm
* Weight Range: 3.3 — 5.2 g for full range of sizes 4 — 15

## **Water Resistance**

* Water resistant to 100m/328ft

## **Battery**

* [Up to 8 days of battery life](https://support.ouraring.com/hc/en-us/articles/360046218953-Ring-Battery-Tips)\*
* Typically charges fully in 20-80 minutes, depending on the battery level
* Lithium-ion rechargeable battery

*\*All battery claims depend on Oura Ring size, Oura App settings, feature configuration, activity, age of battery, usage, and many other factors; actual results will vary. Battery life and charge cycles vary by use and settings. Battery tests were conducted across various sizes and scenarios.*
